RateFlip Privacy Policy
Last updated: April 7, 2026
1. Information We Collect RateFlip does not collect any personal information. The app only stores your preferences (theme and language settings) locally on your device.
2. Exchange Rate Data We obtain exchange rate data from third-party APIs. We do not control or responsibility for the accuracy of third-party exchange rate data.
3. Local Storage Your settings (theme, language) are stored locally on your device using SharedPreferences. No data is transmitted to our servers.
4. Advertisements We display advertisements through Google AdMob. Google may collect and use data for ad personalization. Please refer to Google\'s Privacy Policy for more information.
5. Contact Us If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at: support@rateflip.com

5. Limitation of Liability RateFlip shall not be liable for any decisions made based on the exchange rate information provided by the app.
6. Changes to Terms We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the app constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
7. Contact For questions about these terms, please contact: support@rateflip.com
